label: PF Backlog 386
title: Shared-path reservation (module lock) + common-code detection (allowlist + git hotspots) for parallel workers
body: Design + implement a runtime advisory reservation (path/module/glob lock, TTL, single-writer store) so concurrent workers do not edit shared/common code at once; classify shared code via a component/path allowlist config AND a git-hotspot heuristic; scheduler defers overlapping tasks; worker acquires before editing, releases on merge; WIP snapshotted on the worker branch only. Spec now, implement in ENG-8.
